title: JANUS C2 Metabolic Duplex — electricity / CO2 / C2 simulation
classification_note: Self-classified for registry navigation as a useful conceptual design pattern plus speculative thought experiment requiring external biological/engineering review; this is not an independent audit classification.
purpose: Explore a hypothetical electricity -> CO2 -> C2 carrier -> virtual metabolism architecture while keeping a separate luminal/gut-signal proxy and a non-authoritative ESP32 TWAI/CAN telemetry layer.
claim_ceiling: This is a deterministic architectural simulation, not a human-feeding experiment.
Acetate or another C2 carrier is not claimed to be complete nutrition.
The selected efficiencies are assumptions, not measured efficiencies of an integrated biological system.
The gut_proxy variable is dimensionless and has no clinical calibration or validated biological timescale.
No human dose, infusion rate, medical-device control, or clinical recommendation is encoded.
A stable result inside the model is not evidence that a corresponding real organism would remain healthy or viable.
core_hypothesis: Food-like support can be decomposed into at least two independent modeled functions: a material/energy carrier channel and a luminal signaling channel. The simulation asks whether an electricity-to-C2 architecture can satisfy an abstract energy demand while the signaling channel is evaluated independently.

derived_architectural_thresholds.boundary: These values are consequences of the selected simulation parameters only and are not physiological predictions.

can_profile.authority_rule: TWAI/CAN telemetry is non-authoritative; missing frames must not invent or mutate local simulation state.

scenario_results.input: 420 W for 24 h; luminal proxy intact
420 W except outage from hour 8 to 12
420 W except outage from hour 8 to 16
420 W for 24 h; luminal signal proxy set to zero
420 W for 24 h; deterministic 20% frame-drop probability during hour 4 to 8

interpretation.primary_result: Inside the chosen model, an energy PASS is not sufficient for a whole-system PASS because the independent luminal-signal proxy can fail while the abstract energy channel remains stable.
interpretation.minimal_gate: SYSTEM_PASS := ENERGY_PASS AND SIGNAL_PASS AND MATERIAL_BALANCE_PASS AND SAFETY_PASS

evidence_basis.claim_supported: Acetate is a real human metabolic substrate but is not thereby complete nutrition.
CO2-derived acetate can serve as an intermediate substrate in engineered bioproduction systems.
evidence_basis.identifier: Nature Communications (2025), CO2-to-acetate / engineered yeast starch production

evidence_basis.claim_supported: Enteral/luminal deprivation can affect intestinal mucosal and barrier biology.
evidence_basis.identifier: reviewed parenteral-vs-enteral nutrition literature; current clinical interpretation requires primary-source review

next_gate: Replace assumed efficiencies and qualitative signal proxy with literature-bounded ranges, uncertainty propagation, mass-balance constraints, and explicit nitrogen/essential-nutrient channels before making any stronger biological interpretation.
